paper_title: Axion Star Explosions: A New Source for Axion Indirect Detection
notes: Indirect/cosmological constraint from axion star explosions reionizing the IGM, compared to Planck CMB Thomson optical depth (tau_reio, 95% CL). Main result excludes an approximately closed 2D band in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane: 1e-14 GeV^-1 <~ g_agamma <~ 1e-10 GeV^-1 for 10^-14 eV <~ m_a <~ 10^-8 eV (benchmark core-halo relation alpha=2/5). Exact exclusion contour is from Figure 3 which is not machine-readable; the data_points are ROUGH estimates of the lower (best-sensitivity) boundary of the excluded band inferred from the text/Eq.(3) and abstract ranges, NOT digitized values. Model-dependent (assumes enhanced g_agamma or suppressed axion self-coupling). 21cm improvement is a projection but is NOT the primary result. Not a haloscope, so no local DM density set. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 7))
